research_rationale: EO 13613 (signed 2012-05-21, 77 FR 31155, May 24, 2012) fixes the order in which listed Department of Commerce officials act as Secretary of Commerce under the Federal Vacancies Reform Act, subject to its exceptions in section 2, and in section 3 revokes EO 13242 and the October 3, 2002 memorandum. The held Federal Register text was read in full and its sixteen-clause inventory matches it (preamble, section 1 and items (a) to (i), section 2 and items (b) and (c), sections 3 and 4). The order states no duration or sunset. The three bounded searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121, eCFR and GovInfo CFR, and the Federal Register executive-order catalog) located no instrument that amends, revokes or supersedes it, and no held later instrument is attached. Section 3 is a self-executing revocation that was performed when the order took effect and is recorded as terminated by performance; every other clause is a continuing designation or limitation and is carried as operative on the original-plus-bounded-search basis.
savings_reason: The order contains no savings clause and section 4 disclaims any enforceable right or benefit, so no independent right or obligation survives apart from the designations themselves. The revocation in section 3 left no pending or accrued matter that the order preserves; the three bounded searches located nothing that preserves a residual effect.
earlier_end_check: The order has no sunset, expiry date, report deadline or condition. No held instrument revokes, supersedes or amends it before 2026-10-14: the later-event chain in the dossier is empty and the Federal Register catalog search recorded no disposition note naming it other than its own revocation of EO 13242. Section 3 alone ended earlier (its own performance on 2012-05-21).
scope_check: Section 1 names nine offices in order, section 2 limits who may act, section 3 revokes two earlier instruments and section 4 disclaims enforceable rights. Each is its own clause in the held inventory, which I compared against the full held text; none is missing.
independent_command_check: Sections 1 and 2 are continuing commands independent of one another and of section 3; section 3's revocation of EO 13242 and the 2002 memorandum was complete on issuance and does not depend on sections 1 or 2 continuing. Section 4 is a disclaimer that applies for as long as the order stands.
savings_check: No savings clause exists; the revocation in section 3 is complete and section 4 creates no rights, so no residual obligation continues independently.
